name: BFA
title: BFA — Bachelor of Fine Arts
intro: The fine arts roadmap: portfolio and entrance tests, four years of studio practice, exhibitions and careers.

phases.title: Class 11–12 and early practice
phases.summary: Any stream is accepted; regular drawing practice matters most.
points: BFA colleges ask for Class 12 pass in any stream, with minimum marks as per the college.
Practise sketching, still life, observation and colour work daily.
Visit museums, galleries and art fairs, and study art history basics.
Start building a portfolio of drawings and paintings.

phases.title: Entrance tests and portfolio
phases.summary: College entrance, drawing test and interview.
points: Colleges such as Jamia Millia Islamia, BHU, MS University Baroda, Jadavpur University and others run their own exams; some central universities use CUET-UG.
Tests usually include drawing from observation, memory or composition, and a general-aptitude paper.
Prepare a portfolio and be ready for an interview about your work.
Apply to several colleges, because tests are held separately.

phases.title: Foundation year
points: Learn drawing, colour theory, design fundamentals and materials.
Take art history and aesthetics courses.
Try different media: pencil, charcoal, watercolour, oil, clay and digital.
Experiment before choosing a specialisation.

phases.title: Specialisation years
phases.summary: Painting, sculpture, printmaking, applied art or art history.
points: Choose a major such as painting, sculpture, printmaking, applied art, ceramics or photography.
Take studio courses, workshops and critiques.
Join exhibitions, camps and residencies.
Complete a final-year thesis exhibition.

phases.title: Careers and higher study
phases.summary: Artist, illustrator, designer, art teacher or curator.
points: Careers: professional artist, illustrator, art director, graphic designer, art teacher, restorer and gallery curator.
Higher study: MFA, MA Art History, museum studies or design programmes.
Apply to scholarships such as those from the Ministry of Culture.
Build a website and join galleries and online platforms to sell work.
